open_points.text: white space being the code points of the imported `WHITE_SPACE_CODE_POINTS` constant (A02 rule 1)
open_points.question: What exact exported type and representation does `WHITE_SPACE_CODE_POINTS` use, and therefore what value does `given_values` test for membership: Unicode characters or integer code-point numbers?
options: one string containing the 25 Unicode characters
an immutable collection of one-character strings
an immutable collection of integer code-point numbers
open_points.default_guess: one string containing each of the 25 Unicode characters exactly once, consistent with the statement that the other constants are scalars

witness.initial: State 4 must type `WHITE_SPACE_CODE_POINTS` and the imported value consumed by `given_values`.
events: The data-provider contract author represents the constant as integer code points.
The given-values implementer treats the imported members as Unicode characters when checking an input character.
outcomes: The two modules use the same character representation and U+00A0-only input is read as missing.
The provider supplies integer 160 while the consumer tests the character U+00A0, so U+00A0-only input is read as present.
witness.observer: the owner submitting a required value containing only U+00A0, and the Factory integration test
